senses.zh_definition: Singham，专名，可用作姓名或作品名称；已核实的一个用例是 2011 年印度印地语动作电影《Singham》。
senses.en_definition: A proper name occurring as a personal name or title, including the Indian Hindi-language action film Singham (2011).
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang boleh merujuk kepada orang atau judul karya; salah satu rujukan yang disahkan ialah filem aksi Hindi Singham terbitan 2011.
senses.nuances: 未核实为马来语普通词，不标为 official，也不能仅凭拼写把它释为马来语“狮子”。输入缺少上下文，电影义只是已核实的可能指称。此处马来语释义为编辑说明。影片制作方确认了该片名称及 2011 年的发行背景。[Reliance Entertainment 官方资料](https://www.relianceentertainment.com/reliance-entertainments-singham-crosses-rs-100-crores-net/)。下列为电影语境示范搭配，未核实其语料频率。

etymology.historical_story: Cinema provides a documented cultural route for encountering this spelling. Reliance Entertainment identifies Singham as its 2011 action film, directed by Rohit Shetty and starring Ajay Devgn. That establishes a title, not a Malay common noun. The packet does not identify its referent, so a deeper name etymology remains unverified here. [Producer's account](https://www.relianceentertainment.com/reliance-entertainments-singham-crosses-rs-100-crores-net/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Singham 想成电影海报上完整的大标题，整体识别并保留大写 S；不要拆成马来语词根和词缀。
